name: dither
title: Dither
description: The page dissolves through an ordered Bayer dither — dots, checkerboard, weave, solid — and the next page is revealed the same way in reverse. Drawn on a canvas. GSAP.
docs:
Wrap your layout with the transition. This is the only step:

  // app/layout.tsx
  import { DitherTransition } from "@/components/dither"

  export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
    return (
      <html lang="en">
        <body>
          <DitherTransition>{children}</DitherTransition>
        </body>
      </html>
    )
  }

Your existing <Link>s are intercepted automatically.

A grid of square cells fills the screen in Bayer order — a sparse lattice, then
the checkerboard, then the weave, then solid — and clears in reverse to reveal
the next page. Each cell pops; nothing fades. cells sets how many across
(rows follow the aspect ratio), matrix picks the Bayer size: 4 is the classic
console fade, 8 is smoother, 2 is four blunt stages.

Colour: four palettes ship as classes — palette="ink" (default), "paper",
"blueprint" or "ember". For anything else pass palette="custom" and set
--dither-ground yourself in components/transitions.css.

Note: browser back/forward is not animated, and the route does not start
loading until the leave phase finishes (~0.5s).
